diagnosis: The checks C1, C2, and C3 passed because the lone decision-maker used the public fact S4, which states 'The 0.14 percent result supports releasing all 600 kilograms, while the exact procedure requires 3 sample locations and a 0.20 percent maximum moisture limit.' This fact allowed the decision-maker to make decisions that aligned with the conditions specified in PF1, even though PF1 was never accessible to them. Specifically, the decision-maker used the 0.14 percent result to justify releasing all 600 kilograms and the requirement for 3 sample locations, bypassing the need for PF1.
